## Synopsis

Prints one row per request, a held call and a ticket alike, with the columns ID,
STATE, REQUESTER, SUMMARY, ROLES, EXPIRES and DECIDED BY. ROLES names the roles
whose holders may decide it. --wide prints each request as a block instead.

```
strazactl approvals list [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl approvals list
  strazactl approvals list --wide
```

## Options

```
      --state string   which requests to list: pending, approved, denied, expired or all (default "pending")
      --wide           detail view: add the redacted call preview and the line that says what an approval covers
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
